title: "Tranquil Tides" in Seacrest Beach, 30A | Coast Property Management – Coast Properties
meta_description: "Tranquil Tides" in Seacrest Beach, 30A | Coast Property Management
description_expanded: Welcome to “Tranquil Tides” – A Luxurious 5-Bedroom, 5.5-Bathroom Wooded Haven in Seacrest Beach, FL LOCATION: Tucked away in the gated Treetop community in Seacrest Beach, this home is perfectly positioned between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach and offers the ultimate blend of tranquility and adventure for families, friends, or couples seeking a memorable getaway. The home is less than a mile to the private deeded beach access within Seacrest (the community offers a shuttle service to/from the private access), or just under a mile and a half to the large Inlet Beach regional access point. 30Avenue shops and restaurants are a short drive or bike ride away. PROPERTY OVERVIEW: • Sleeps 14 • Steps from the community pool • Includes four beach cruisers • Shuttle service to/from private beach access  First Floor: • The chef’s kitchen comes with premium appliances, a gas range, both drip & K-cup coffee makers, and all necessary cookware, utensils, and glassware. There is additional seating for four at the breakfast bar. • The living room includes a smart TV, two couches and two armchairs • A powder room • The dining area provides seating for eight • The garage houses four premium beach cruisers, as well as some beach gear and toys. Second Floor: • Bedroom 1 – King bed, en suite with soaking tub and shower, balcony • Bedroom 2 – Queen bed, en suite with shower • Bedroom 3 – Queen bed, en suite with shower/tub combo • Laundry room with washer and dryer Third Floor: • Bedroom 4 – King bed, en suite with bath tub, shower, and balcony • Bedroom 5 – Bunk Room (2x twin/full beds), shower/tub combo • Loft area with seating and TV To enhance your stay, we also provide a starter supply of premium, eco-friendly guest essentials, including: Body Wash, Shampoo & Conditioner Hand Soap, Dish Soap & Dishwasher Pods Toilet Paper, Paper Towels & Facial Tissues ️ Trash Bags & Dish Sponge Laundry Detergent GUEST SUPPORT: Need assistance? Coast’s dedicated management team is available to help with anything you need—just send us a message! IMPORTANT NOTES: Age Requirement: The primary guest must be 25 or older to book. Parking: A maximum of two vehicles is permitted within the community. The home has two private parking spots. Check-In Policy: Please do not arrive before your scheduled check-in time unless prior arrangements have been made and approved. Pet Policy: We accept one pet per stay, up to 65 lbs. No pets are allowed on furniture/beds, or in the community pool, showers, or bathtubs. Pets should not be left unattended at the property for more than four hours unless crated. No Smoking: The home is strictly non-smoking. Violations will result in immediate eviction and loss of rental fees, with the guest responsible for any damages. Construction Notice: Like many 30A communities, the area is actively growing, and construction noise may be present during your stay. By booking this property, you acknowledge that no discounts or refunds will be issued due to construction activity.

Cleanliness: All towels and bedding washed in hot water that's at least 60ºC
